segments.summary: four agent nodes (white rounded hexagon badges carrying logo icons) at the corners pop in with overshoot, four gray labels and a centred 7-word headline pop in word by word, four connectors draw on, dots relay from node to node along the connectors; the headline then fades in place while the network persists

the persistent network gains two midpoint nodes and a 3-word headline in the same slot while the network plane pulls back 1.000 -> 0.291 about the frame centre (log-space ease-in-out, 90 f), revealing a triangular node lattice: the inner nodes slide in across the frame edges, the outer nodes of the four half-lattice rows pop in place in 10 mirrored pairs (f158-f195, lower half 4-5 f ahead) and the connectors draw on in mirrored 5-frame waves until f206; dots keep relaying; a soft knock-out glow keeps the headline clean; everything fades out together

product UI: two dark terminal windows stacked on the left and a white chat panel on the right grow-fade in (2 f stagger) under a centred 5-word headline popping word by word; a request bubble fades in, the message list steps up in single frames while new rows fade in, dots carry each message between chat and terminals (15 f per hop), terminal lines and streamed words pop (the bottom terminal's first line on a full-width row highlight band, f350 to the exit), status timers count; panels shrink-fade out
a single large centred word pops in after two empty frames, holds 47 f, fades out in place
brand mark pops in with a small overshoot, a centred 2-word line pops word by word below it, then a gray monospace URL line pops below; the group holds and fades out in place

product UI built left to right (two gray device labels, a narrow chat panel, two dark terminals) under a centred 7-word headline; the S03 chat/terminal choreography with three windows (chat -> terminal -> terminal -> terminal -> chat packet hops); panels shrink-fade out

a single large word with period pops in one frame (f791) after three empty frames, centred and placed above the frame centre; 53 f later a 2-word sub line pops below it word by word (f844, f851); the card holds and both lines fade out together in place (ease-in, 8 f, no scale)

logo marquee: a row of agent logo icons on white rounded flat-top hexagon plates (one dark plate with the brand mark) and grey labels scrolls left at a constant 9.333 px/f under a centred heading; the 1-word heading fades out and a 2-word heading pops word by word; the row stops dead after exactly 7 slots, then the badges swap to black hexagons that gather into a honeycomb (T08)

end card built from the honeycomb's centre cell: the cells collapse into one black hexagon (end of T08), its two eye bars pop as dashes and open, the mark slides left with an ease-in-out, the 2-word wordmark, the 2-word tagline and the URL line pop in one frame each; static hold to the last frame, no fade
